note: Claim gates for the EurekaZero paper. Status vocabulary: protocol (a definition or design the paper contributes now), proposed (a result the paper will claim only after its evidence exists), synthetic-north-star (shown in this draft with synthetic numbers; not established), do-not-assert (no finite experiment can support it). Historical InnovationZero claim identifiers (IZ-E01 and following) remain unchanged in docs/paper/innovationzero/evidence/claims.json.

claims.claim: One interface accommodates observed data, optimization histories and engineering specifications as innovation-game states.
claims.minimum_evidence: Implemented typed adapters and complete examples for each domain that serialize and validate.

claims.claim: The strict track commits one candidate before any candidate-specific feedback.
claims.minimum_evidence: Supervisor-recorded counters and complete receipts for every evaluated run.

claims.claim: The proposer generates outside the complete-artifact archive.
claims.minimum_evidence: An open-support decoder with output and provenance checks against the frozen archive.

claims.claim: First-proposal utility improves on unseen learning-task families.
claims.minimum_evidence: Locked family-level comparison against strong retrieval, selection, direct-generation and frontier controls.
Matched frozen-history confirmation and an equal-budget closed-loop comparison.

claims.claim: Generated CAD meets specifications with useful engineering performance.
claims.minimum_evidence: Valid editable outputs and qualified independent engineering evaluation, with physical tests where claimed.

claims.claim: The solution representation and outcome training materially help.
claims.minimum_evidence: Matched direct-decoder, imitation-only, retrieval and catalog ablations, and objective interventions.

claims.claim: A shared model benefits from cross-domain training.
claims.minimum_evidence: Matched joint-versus-separate transfer study with negative transfer reported.

claims.claim: Training on fresh verified outcomes improves the next model.
claims.minimum_evidence: Controlled improvement rounds against equal-compute static controls on a frozen evaluation.

claims.claim: A specific new mechanism has been discovered.
claims.minimum_evidence: Prospective dossier, prior-work scope, causal intervention and independent replication.

claims.claim: The method reduces deployment resources at useful quality.
claims.minimum_evidence: Full quality-cost comparison with metered costs and stated amortization volume.

claims.claim: The approach generalizes to all innovation.
claims.minimum_evidence: No finite experiment can establish this unrestricted claim; the paper states the innovation-game hypothesis and its scope instead.
